hypothesis: MUR reduces total generated policy+critic tokens by >=40% against per-step Guided Search with accuracy loss <=2pp. This task only implements and validates the smoke gate.
baseline: Stepwise CoT and per-step Guided Search; Qwen3-1.7B BF16 with GenPRM-1.5B. Exact protocol in PROTOCOL.md.
intervention: Bias-corrected EMA alpha=0.9, gamma=0.9; no scaling first step; scale four candidates only when proposal mean NLL exceeds corrected history-log(gamma).
dataset: Pinned HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500 revision in configs/sources.json for eventual full test; prepare 20 held-out development MATH training questions with fixed revision and hashes, excluding normalized test questions.
split: 20 development questions only in this task. Prepare full 500-test manifest but do not generate or tune on test.
primary_metric: Gate validity, then total generated tokens (policy+critic, lower better); pass@1 guardrail. No scientific success claim from smoke.
decision_rule: Pass only with the explicitly amended same-engine signal gate on all8 probes, complete20x3 smoke/evaluation and resource/ledger evidence. Report original HF parity failure separately. No full test until supervisor review.
controls: Read PROTOCOL.md validation amendment, configs/validation.json and experiments/mur-20261024-prep-r3/review.md. Previous HF parity test FAILED and MUST remain failed in reporting. This task implements a distinct raw-signal gate with a frozen reference change, not a tolerance relaxation.

Reuse all existing runtime assets and the observed working V1 memory fractions: policy0.42, critic0.62, verifier0.40. Never set global profiles or install shared dependencies. Official task-local DSH permission mode is already configured under user authorization.

Implement a separate mur.validate_signal module using configs/validation.json. Generate all8 frozen synthetic prompts with original T0.6/top_p0.8/top_k20/presence1.5 and raw logprobs=0; save exact prompt/output token IDs and raw vectors. Generation in one short-lived process; teacher-forced reference in a fresh process/engine after full cleanup. Use same pinned weights, BF16 and default attention backend in both.

Teacher-forced reference must use the exact saved prompt+output IDs, prompt_logprobs=0, identity sampler temperature0/top_p1/top_k-1/presence0, max_tokens1. Verify all output positions including boundary positions and EOS; do not score decoded/re-tokenized text. Disable prefix caching for reference or prove prompt_logprobs forces fresh prefill. Extra probe tokens MUST be counted. No rescoring in main inference.

Apply unchanged max_abs<0.15, mean_abs<0.02, abs_mean<0.005 to EVERY probe. At least8 complete nonempty probes and repeated token coverage. Retain raw numeric vectors to independently recompute. A failed probe => STOP, write BLOCKED; no further GPU diagnosis, sampler/attention variants, tolerance changes or repetitions in this task.

Record validation_reference explicitly in gate/environment/reports. State cross_engine_hf_parity=false and reference_run=mur-20261024-prep-r3. A passing same-engine gate must never be presented as passing HF parity. Inspect and record installed sampler-source hash proving raw_logprobs computed BEFORE penalties/temperature.

After this one signal gate passes, run the same20 development questions for cot/per_step/mur and final verifier using stage_driver. Whole run <=3000GPU seconds and1M output tokens; combinedprep<=2GPU-hours, totalproject<=12. No full500, sweeps, newdataset or hyperparameter changes.

Fix remaining driver bookkeeping BEFORE GPU run: include cleanup time in allocation duration; fail closed if NVML/compute process telemetry is unavailable; do not advance from a phase whose exit/status/cleanup failed even if a stale passed file exists; refuse reused GPU-output directories. Sum actual reported tokens and mark unknown conservative reservations separately.

Keep all processes foreground under current bounded service cgroup. Child process groups used for cleanup are allowed, detached services/nohup are not. RuntimeMaxSec/MemoryMax unchanged. Monitor own GPU allocations<=14GiB and free>=4GiB. Do not kill unrelated processes.

Commit code/config before actual GPU work. Run meaningful CPU tests. Do not modify active running code. No raw benchmark questions/answers, private usernames/paths/host/IPs, credentials or session logs in Git. audit_public staged/history before commits. Relay push only.

Include actual run SHA, failure/fix SHAs, final HEAD and push state. Copy raw-smoke-traces.jsonl to run root for artifact manifest but never Git. Sanitize only numeric per-question and aggregate results.
Inspect genuine MUR triggers and critic parser outputs. If zero genuine triggers, existing marked engineering forced-trigger test is allowed and excluded from metrics. Do not change alpha/gamma.

Report total previous R3 conservative280GPU seconds/300 generated diagnostic tokens separately; do not hide failed gates. R1 incomplete14 trajectories remain excluded. No scientific conclusion from development smoke.

Use original scientific protocol exactly: role markers, accepted-only termination, raw mean NLL with bias-corrected EMA, four fresh candidates, complete proposal/candidate/critic ledger, strict verifier parser and versioned cache. Match source hashes and data manifest.
code_revision: Supervisor environment-resumption task commit at startup; record SHA. Commit every implementation fix before GPU execution.
environment: Remote-only RTX3090 BF16; reuse existing runtime/venv (vLLM0.8.5 V1, transformers4.51.3, torch2.6.0+cu124). No shared environment mutations.
experiment_commands: runtime/venv/bin/python scripts/stage_driver.py --run-dir "$MUR_RUN_DIR" --run-id mur-20261024-prep-r4 --gpu-index 2 --gpu-budget-seconds 3000 --wall-budget-seconds 7000 --token-budget 1000000 --max-new-mib 14336 --min-free-mib 4096 # driver validation command must use mur.validate_signal

budget.model_cost_limit: One remote GPU, <=3000 allocation seconds including every phase and cleanup. <=1 million generated tokens. Existing DSH subscription only. One signal validation attempt; no exploratory GPU runs after failure.

stop_conditions: Disk free would drop below25GiB or newstorage20GiB
Wrong source revision, test leakage or unsafe path/credential in staging
Need to change scientific protocol; report BLOCKED to supervisor
